summary: Wrote the six-phase implementation plan for a new generic typescript extension, with an embedded Design Specification section covering all eight required outcomes: the 20-file manifest with line budgets, the strictly-generic context/project/typescript/ tree, both Sonnet-tier agents' stages and tool grants, the hard_contracts block plus its domain-prefixed override contract text, the keyword_overrides set with a first-hand collision check re-derived across all 24 extension manifests and the core weak-signal table, the four-glob rules paths frontmatter, the verification-stage hook's full input/detection/exit-code/honest-degrade contract, and the line-level split of web's typescript-web.md. Waves are [1,2,3,4] / [5] / [6]; 9 hours estimated. Re-deriving the research report's carried figures corrected five errors in it (missing skills pair, wrong provides.scripts form, missing extensions README table row, 303-vs-304 line count, and an astro/zod import inside the range the report called pure Zod). The plan passes validate-artifact.sh in --strict mode with zero warnings, and plan-file-scope-harvest.sh yields 21 concrete paths with no coarse glob.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase implementation plan plus embedded design specification for the new generic typescript extension.
